split.name: official
split.fit_50: the 1680 official Train rows with the smallest sha256('css-v0-50pct/<row_id>')
split.eval: the same official Valid / Test rows for both training sizes

target.name: whole_molecule_lipophilicity
target.normalization: fit-only z-score, re-fit per training size
target.metric: RMSE in original label units (whole graph)

descriptor.root_object: complete radius-2 induced ego graph R2(v) of a real root atom v

blocks.ROOT: one-hot of the root atom's 9 official OGB categorical fields
blocks.S1: joint count of (neighbour atomic number, bond type) over real neighbours
blocks.S2: joint count of (middle atomic number, first bond type, second bond type, end atomic number, closure) over real non-backtracking rooted 2-paths v-w-u, u != v
blocks.EGO_ATOM: per root distance 0/1/2, category counts of each of the 9 official OGB atom fields
blocks.EGO_BOND: per unordered endpoint-distance pair, category counts of each of the 3 official OGB bond fields over real induced R2 bonds

descriptor.weighting: per block: sqrt(count) then L2 normalisation; empty block stays zero; concat five blocks and divide by sqrt(5)
forbidden: additional connected subgraph enumeration of size 3-6

projection.vocabulary: per training size, built only from the corresponding Fit roots
projection.post: L2 normalise every projected root descriptor (zero-safe)
projection.dim_rule: always 64; if fewer effective dimensions exist, zero-pad and report

references.selection: fixed seed-0 k-means++ D^2 sampling over the Fit z_v; the selected point is always a real Fit root; no Lloyd update; no duplicate projected vector
references.temperature: tau = max(1e-6, median_Fit(d_8th^2)), d_8th = eighth nearest reference
references.sparsification: none (no top-k, no hard assignment, no sparsity penalty)

branch.normalisation: (t - mean_Fit(t)) / max(global_RMS_Fit, 1e-6); global RMS over every centred Fit root and dimension

recipe.checkpoint: best official Valid RMSE (ties keep the earlier epoch)

horizon.rule: largest common horizon whose measured throughput, with a 25% timing margin, fits the 10-minute per-run target and the 0.5 GPU-hour total; never changed after seeing validation performance

evaluation.primary: whole-graph RMSE in original label units
evaluation.comparison: gain = RMSE(DIRECT) - RMSE(SHARE); positive = SHARE better
